codeSamples.code:
<?php

$baseUrl = 'https://api.spryng.nl/v2/groups';
$ch = curl_init();

$baseUrl =  $baseUrl . '?groupId=Array';

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $baseUrl);

$headers = [
     'X-Api-Key' => 'YOUR_KEY_HERE'
    ];

curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);


curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);

$response = curl_exec($ch);
$info = curl_getinfo($ch);

curl_close($ch);

if ($info['http_code'] >= 400) {
    echo 'Error! HTTP code: ' . $info['http_code'] . ', Response: ' . $response;
} else {
    echo 'Success! Response: ' . $response;
}
?>

sections.title: API overview
sections.content:
This endpoint allows you to delete a single group in a single API call. Deleting a group does not delete the contacts within the group or delete any other groups which the contact may be associated to. This is the perfect tool for maintaining your contact list from another system, such as a CRM, an e-commerce platform, or a customer database, ensuring your contacts are always up-to-date.

Before you start using this endpoint, please check you have your Account, API Key and Base URL set up and have familiarised yourself with our implementation prerequisites.

sections.title: Headers
sections.content:
These parameters are mandatory to be provided in the header of your request. If not provided, or incorrect, your request will fail.

HeaderTypeDescription
X-Api-KeyStringAPI Key value for authorization

Example request header:
DELETE https://api.spryng.nl/v2/groups/{groupId}
-H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'

sections.title: Responses
sections.content:
The standard responses for this API are listed below. For a full list of possible REST API status codes, please refer to this guide.

Success
200 OK
Success response with empty body.

Error codes
400 Bad Request
The server was unable to process the request due to missing or invalid groupId provided.
Response example
{
    "errors": [
        {
            "errorCode": "group_ids_empty",
            "errorMessage": "At least one group id must be specified."
        }
    ]
}

401 Unauthorized
The server was unable to process the request due to a missing or invalid authentication value.
Response example
{
    "title": "An error occurred while processing the request",
    "status": 401,
    "message": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups' was unauthenticated",
    "errors": {},
    "internalErrors": [
        {
            "message": "Pipeline",
            "metadata": {
                "unauthenticatedError": "Request for authenticated route '/v2/groups' was unauthenticated"
            }
        }
    ]
}
